business_scope.primary_industry_name: Contract Research Organization (CRO) for Multinational Drug Trials

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European tradition with codified commercial and administrative law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement (2013, with Peru and Ecuador)
Colombia–United Kingdom Trade Agreement (2020, transitional) and Colombia–UK Double Taxation Agreement (2019)
Colombia–Spain Double Taxation Agreement (2005, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (commercial registry consolidation); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF AML authority); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT duties); Decreto 830 de 2021 (final beneficiary definition and 5% disclosure threshold); Ley 2195 de 2022 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales, RUBF); Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of existence and legal representation of each non-resident corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registrar in the shareholder's home country (e.g., US State Secretary, Companies House, equivalent registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a Party to the Hague Apostille Convention; no consular legalization required for Member States)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) for incorporation, executed by each non-resident shareholder or its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and identity/address proof of each non-resident director, legal representative and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government authority with recognition before a Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Consular Legalization in non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record / good-standing certificate of the proposed foreign legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police or judicial authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, with sworn Spanish translation by a Colombian interpreter

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio of the registered address (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal registry document – no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, UBOs, and sponsor counterparties against: (i) Colombian national sanctions lists (Listas Vinculantes under Decreto 1068 de 2015); (ii) Colombian PEP databases maintained by the Secretaría de Transparencia and UIAF SIAF systems; (iii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iv) OFAC SDN List; (v) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (vi) UK HM Treasury sanctions list; and (vii) INTERPOL red-notice and adverse-media indices. Enhanced due diligence and prior approval by the Money Laundering Compliance Officer (Oficial de Cumplimiento) are mandatory for any PEP, high-risk jurisdiction, or sanctioned counterparty; all results must be evidenced in a written AML report retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rrues.org.co, with e-services of the applicable Cámara de Comercio (e.g., 'CCB en Línea' of Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) for the Certificado de Homonimia.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must be drafted in Spanish, using the Latin alphabet with standard Spanish orthography. Foreign words or abbreviations may be used but must be legally transliterated and clearly distinguishable; the corporate type indicator 'S.A.S.' must appear in the full corporate name. Accented characters and diacritics are permitted. The homonimia search is performed on an exact and phonetic basis, and the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered trademark or corporate denomination.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A Certificado de Homonimia cannot be formally extended; upon expiry, a new certificate must be requested, which restarts the 30-day window. If the Cámara de Comercio rejects the proposed name, the applicant, within ten business days of notification, may file a reconsideration motion (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara and, in the alternative or in the same petition, an appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) in accordance with CPACA (Ley 1437 de 2011, arts. 74–76). The appeal must be in Spanish, identify the conflicting antecedent, explain why the name is distinguishable, and propose admissible variations. Simultaneously, a fresh homonimia certificate may be ordered for the next preferred name variant.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditional. Decreto 1074 de 2015 and Chamber of Commerce practice require a verifiable physical domicile in the registered municipality where the legal representative receives official notifications. A virtual office or co-working license is accepted only if the suite is a lawful operating address and the Cámara de Comercio can serve notices; however, for a clinical-trial CRO operating under INVIMA and Sponsor oversight, a dedicated physical office with controlled document custody and monitoring visit capacity is strongly recommended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for corporate registry purposes – approximately 5–8% probability per fiscal year of a registry verification visit. High probability of documented premises inspections by INVIMA and the National Institute of Health (INS) once clinical trial files are stored at the registered office; concurrent tax and labor on-site audits occur in approximately 15–20% of active S.A.S. cases within the first three years of operation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff set by Colombian decree and prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration rights (derechos de inscripción) for the incorporation in the commercial registry
Mercantile registration (matrícula mercantil) of the S.A.S. (first year, based on registered capital of approx. USD 30,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Municipal/Departmental Treasury of the registered domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tax rate (0.5%–1% of capital depending on the department)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority in the shareholders' jurisdictions (e.g., US State Secretary / Colombian Consulate)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille and consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents by a certified translator
Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) preparation and initial filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fee for registry processing and professional compliance preparation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio Arts. 98-143, 353-379; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (registration procedures); Ley 1437 de 2011 (administrative procedure rules)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local branch, e.g. Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating under the Superintendencia de Sociedades and the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) filed electronically through the RUES portal, or public deed if patrimonial real estate is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under Ley 1258 de 2008; share capital freely set by shareholders, may be deferred up to two years; no escrow account legally required, but cash contributions exceeding one monthly minimum wage must be deposited in a Colombian financial institution in the company's name
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [SAS NAME], S.A.S. – FIRST MEETING: The shareholder(s), constituting the General Assembly, resolve as follows: (1) Ratify the subscription of shares, each equal to COP [amount] at par value, and accept the statutory share capital, acknowledging payment terms as per the incorporation document. (2) Adopt as registered office the address: [address, municipality, department], including the physical establishment as the principal place of business for all legal and tax notices. (3) Appoint [Name] as sole Manager/President and [Name] as Alternate Manager, granting broad powers per Article 9 of the by-laws. (4) Authorize opening of corporate bank accounts, obtaining the tax ID (NIT), and executing any ancillary instrument required for operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio – RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co) or any authorized chamber window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a digital application for certificate of name availability (certificado de homonimia) via the RUES portal; select a proposed corporate name (e.g., [name] S.A.S.); pay the nominal search fee. The system will issue a negative or affirmative certification within one business day; the name is reserved for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Application form (Formulario Único de Registro - Registro de Homologación)
Identification of incorporators (cédula / passport / RUT)
Payment receipt of search fee (approx. USD 2)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is unavailable, present two alternative names; the application is automatically modified and reprocessed without additional fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the private incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators / notary (only required for full public deed if real estate is contributed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, containing by-laws, share issuance, capital payment terms, corporate object, governance clauses, and representation. Execute before a notary when contributions include immovable property; otherwise, sign by all shareholders. The document must be uploaded to RUES for registration.
required_dossiers: Proposed by-laws (estatutos)
Certificate of name pre-approval
Identification documents of each shareholder
RUT (tax registry) of each shareholder if Colombian resident
Power of attorney if any shareholder acts through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUES validator rejects the document for incompleteness, correct the specific deficiencies within 10 business days and resubmit; a second review is done at no extra cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration with Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES) – Superintendencia de Sociedades (oversight)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the private instrument is uploaded, execute the 'Registro de Libros' (book registration), submit the incorporation document, and complete the Unique Business Registry (RUES) form. The chamber will authenticate the entity, assign the mercantile registration number (matrícula mercantil), and issue the certificate of incorporation and the company's establishment card. The entire registration typically takes 3–5 business days.
required_dossiers: Executed Documento Privado de Constitución (or public deed)
Formulario Único de Registro (pre-filled RUES form)
Payment of registration fees (tariff based on capital, minimum approx. USD 35)
Certificate of name pre-approval
Identification and residency proof of administrators
Lease agreement or proof of address for registered office (when using physical premises)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an objection (observación) for mismatched data, file a written response within 15 calendar days, amend the instrument, and resubmit; re-tariff applies only for additional filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and NIT (RUT) before DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the commercial registration certificate, access the DIAN portal (www.dian.gov.co) using the newly issued NIT (once it is pre-assigned by RUES), complete the Registro Único Tributario form (Formulario 036), and select the correct tax responsibilities (e.g., income tax, VAT, ICA, and source withholding). Obtain the final RUT with the electronic signature certificate (from a TDCA provider) to enable electronic invoicing.
required_dossiers: Original certificate of incorporation and commercial registration (Cámara de Comercio)
Identity documents of the legal representative and accountant
Proof of the registered office address
Banking information for tax refunds (if applicable)
Electronic signature request from DIAN-approved provider (e.g., GSE, Certicámara)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects RUT updates due to incorrect tax scheme classification, file a corrective form 0129 and, if needed, submit a reclassification request with legal grounds; DIAN must resolve within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate governance registration and statutory book authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company's statutory books (share register, board/minutes book, and members' registry) with Cámara de Comercio. Adopt the first board resolution and incorporate it in the minutes book. Obtain a certificate of legal representation and good standing for the officers. Register any additional powers of attorney in the same book.
required_dossiers: Minutes book (Libro de Actas)
Share registry (Registro de Acciones)
Board of Directors' list and appointments
First Board Resolution minutes
Officer identification documents
Application for book registration (Formulario de Registro de Libros)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If books contain pagination defects, request provisional authorization to replace them; defects are usually cured by correcting the page numbering and submitting a new request with the defective books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sectoral license application for CRO operations (INVIMA / Sanitary registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) – Ministry of Health and Social Protection
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via INVIMA's online platform (www.invima.gov.co) an application for authorization as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) for clinical trials. The file must describe the entity's quality management system, GCP (Good Clinical Practice) compliance, personnel qualifications, and the specific clinical trial protocols intended to be managed. The authorization process is based on compliance with e.g., Resolution 2378 de 2008 and applicative ICH-GCP guidelines.
required_dossiers: RUT and commercial registration certificate
Certificate of legal representation
Corporate governance documents (by-laws, board resolution appointing the technical director)
Quality manual and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for research management
Proof of professional liability/insurance for the CRO (certificate)
Detailed CVs and professional credentials of medical/technical staff
List of planned clinical trial protocols (preliminary or committed)
Ethics committee approval for each trial (if trial-specific submission)
Statement of compliance with data privacy (Ley 1581 de 2012)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INVIMA requires additional documentation, the applicant has 15 business days to respond; appeal rights under Ley 1437 de 2011 allow reconsideration before INVIMA or direct appeal to the Ministry of Health. Extensions may be granted for valid technical reasons.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in conjunction with the Ministry of Health and Social Protection (clinical research regulatory framework), and the local Cámara de Comercio for commercial operating permits
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Cumplimiento de Buenas Prácticas Clínicas para Organizaciones de Investigación por Contrato (GCP Certificate for Contract Research Organizations)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or local municipal environmental authority (Unidad Municipal de Asistencia Técnica Agropecuaria / Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente, as applicable)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – full EIA not required for office-based CRO professional services (ISIC 7490); however, general environmental obligations apply under Ley 1252 de 2008 and Decreto 1076 de 2015
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office wastewater must comply with local sewer standards per Decreto 1076 de 2015 (e.g., maximum pH 6.0–9.0, TSS < 500 mg/L for non-domestic discharges); no VOC emissions generated in ordinary office operations; electronic and clinical waste handling must follow Resolución 1362 de 2020 (electronic waste) and Decreto 4741 de 2005 (hazardous waste segregation and outsourcing to authorized carriers)

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de la localidad (mandatory for any commercial office), structural load inspection for medical/laboratory storage areas is not necessary unless the office hosts heavy equipment; compliance with workplace risk prevention under Resolución 0312 de 2019 (OCCAS and health and safety management system), registration with ARL (adversity risk insurer), and employee medical examinations are mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN). Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; primary transactional platform: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Control Automatizado) at muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity (e.g., a French parent or a foreign shareholder) that will participate in a Colombian S.A.S. or that itself carries on business in Colombia must obtain a Colombian NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) via the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). Step-by-step: (1) Appoint a legal representative or attorney-in-fact domiciled in Colombia, evidenced by a notarized power of attorney, apostilled and officially translated into Spanish; (2) file the foreign entity's certificate of existence (certificado de existencia y representación legal) or equivalent registration documentation, apostilled; (3) submit the RUT application telematically through the MUISCA platform using the credentials of the Colombian-appointed representative, indicating the relevant tax obligations (income tax under Articles 12 and 20-24 of the Estatuto Tributario, VAT, withholding, and if applicable PE registration); (4) obtain the NIT and activate the DIAN electronic signature (firma electrónica) for the representative; (5) if holding Colombian-source revenue, register as a VAT responsible agent and request authorization to issue electronic invoices under the 'validación previa' scheme. Processing time is generally 5-10 business days with complete documentation; the mere acquisition of a NIT/RUT by a foreign entity does not automatically create a permanent establishment, but actual service-delivery activities in Colombia by the CRO should be re-characterized as PE risk under Article 24 of the Estatuto Tributario, reincorporating the OECD/BEPS test. For a newly incorporated S.A.S., the same procedure is completed by the SAS's legal representative and the projected tax ID is issued simultaneously with the RUT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope. A Colombian Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is a capital company subject to Colombian corporate income tax (CIT) at the headline rate of 35% on its worldwide income (territorial extension for worldwide income of Colombian residents, with foreign tax credit relief under Article 12 of the Tax Statute). The SAS is not a pass-through entity for Colombian tax purposes; dividends paid to foreign shareholders are subject to remittance withholding tax (7.5% under the general rate, reduced only if the shareholder is a resident of a treaty jurisdiction). The S.A.S. is not inherently a tax-exempt entity. If the SAS operates as a branch/PE of a foreign entity, the PE is likewise taxed at entity level on Colombian-source income, with branch-remittance WHT on remittances under Article 407 of the Tax Statute.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not have a U.S.-style 'check-the-box' election. The relevant statutory elections are: (i) the SIMPLE regime (régimen simple de tributación), optional for an S.A.S. whose prior-year gross income does not exceed 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.0 billion for FY2025) and that is not engaged in certain excluded activities; SIMPLE consolidates CIT, local taxes and VAT withholding into a single rate between 7% and 14% plus a 0% to 7% industry addition; (ii) the election to apply treaty-reduced dividend rates subject to OECD/BEPS beneficial ownership and substance tests; (iii) the mandatory application (not an election) of hybrid mismatch adjustment rules enacted by Law 1819/2016 (Articles 128-1 to 128-23 of the Tax Statute) which require a classification comparison of hybrid instruments/entities with foreign jurisdictions (e.g., French S.A. vs. Colombian S.A.S. classification) rather than a filing election; (iv) the election to deduct expenses on a cash or accrual basis for certain controlled entities? Not applicable by default. There is no Colombian check-the-box election for entity classification as a disregarded entity; the S.A.S. is always a taxable entity in Colombia.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Colombian Value Added Tax (IVA – Impuesto al Valor Agregado) governed by Articles 420-481 of the Estatuto Tributario and administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no de minimis turnover threshold for legal entities (S.A.S.) providing taxable services in Colombia: registration as an IVA responsable (general regime) is mandatory from the first taxable supply. The simplified IVA regime (régimen simplificado) is available only to natural persons with prior-year gross income below 3,500 UVT and meeting qualitative conditions; it is not available to an S.A.S. Non-resident suppliers of digital services to Colombian final consumers are also subject to mandatory simplified registration without any turnover threshold. For export-oriented CRO services, the SAS must be registered as an IVA-responsible entity with an 'exportador de servicios' status granted by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) with real-time fiscal clearance is fully operative under the 'validación previa' model: since 1 August 2024 all VAT-responsible taxpayers must issue invoices only through DIAN-authorized software (software propio or software tecnológico) and transmit each invoice in UBL/CII XML format to DIAN via certified SOAP/REST APIs; the invoice receives a DIAN authorization number before being issued to the client. Each invoice bears a unique digital stamping code (CUFE – Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) generated from the taxpayer's NIT and invoice data. Export invoices must use the specific 'factura electrónica de venta para exportación' scheme, with the export service declaration filed in MUISCA. A copy of every authorized export invoice is transmitted in real-time to DIAN; failure to obtain prior validation renders the invoice ineffective and may trigger VAT recharacterization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported services are excluded from IVA (effectively 0% VAT) under Article 481(1) of the Estatuto Tributario (amended by Law 1819/2016) when all of the following conditions are met: (i) the services are performed within or from Colombian territory; (ii) the services are used or enjoy exclusive benefit abroad; (iii) the final beneficiaries are non-residents with no domicile or permanent establishment in Colombia; (iv) the consideration is received in foreign currency and the corresponding foreign exchange is surrendered to the Colombian foreign exchange market within the legal period; and (v) the taxpayer has prior registration as an 'exportador de servicios' in the RUT with DIAN. For a clinical-trial CRO, qualifying services include protocol design, clinical data management, biostatistical analysis, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, central laboratory services, and medical writing, provided that the sponsor is a foreign biopharma without a Colombian PE and the data and intellectual outputs are consumed by the sponsor outside Colombia. Services performed in Colombia for a local affiliate with a Colombian PE would not qualify. The taxpayer must also file the annual informative return of export services and maintain documentary evidence of the foreign beneficiary's status.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación de Servicios (Electronic Export Services Declaration) filed through the MUISCA platform with DIAN, including the service contract, scope of work and value
Factura Electrónica de Venta para Exportación (Electronic export invoice) containing the CUFE code and the DIAN validación previa acceptance number

Certificado de cambio / Inward Remittance Certificate (Foreign Exchange Certification) issued by an authorized Colombian financial intermediary evidencing repatriation and sale of the foreign currency on the Colombian exchange market within the 180-day deadline
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN has five (5) years from the due filing date to review and reject an export zero-rating position; where the conditions of Article 481 E.T. are not met, DIAN will retroactively assess the 19% IVA that should have been charged, plus moratory interest calculated from the original due date of each filing and from any IVA refund previously claimed, and will apply the inaccuracy penalty under Article 647 E.T. (10% of the tax difference, or 20% when triggered by false, inexact or unlawful invoices/documents). Unjustified export zero-rating claims that lead to a final IVA assessment are also subject to the general limitations on fiscal audit and to penalty for claim-excess under Article 648 E.T. for excessive compensations/refunds. In case of fraud, the criminal tax evasion provisions of Article 271 of the Colombian Penal Code (as amended by Laws 2010/2019 and 2277/2022) may apply, with imprisonment of 48-108 months when the defrauded amount exceeds the statutory threshold (300 monthly minimum wages); additionally, the exporter may be suspended or removed from the 'exportador de servicios' registry and barred from issuing zero-rated export invoices for a period of 24 months.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (banking supervisor) and the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) as the enforcement authorities of the Colombian foreign exchange regime (Régimen Cambiario). Legal basis: Law 9 of 1991, Resolución Externa No. 8 of 2000 of Banco de la República, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a free-floating exchange rate regime; the Colombian Peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account operations (services, royalties, dividends) and for registered capital-account operations. Current-account inflows and outflows must be channeled through the exchange market (

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) in the Cámara de Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the company's registered domicile; supervised by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each year for registration status as of December 31 of the prior year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest accrual; fines up to approximately USD 337 for delayed renewal; continued non-renewal leads to administrative cancellation of registration and potential strike-off of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and management report if the S.A.S. is required to present them by law (estados financieros de fin de ejercicio)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered with the Cámara de Comercio and available to shareholders; filed with the Superintendencia de Sociedades if the company meets statutory supervision thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of the following fiscal year for the annual general meeting approval; if under mandatory supervision, filing by September 30 of the following fiscal year or per exigencia of the Superintendencia
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers procedural fines and potential administrative sanctions; continued non-compliance may lead to inspection measures and potential involuntary dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of operating and biosecurity permits held by the CRO (e.g., INVIMA health authorization, if applicable to clinical trial services)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) or delegated health authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Typically per the license term; renewal applications filed between 60 and 180 days before expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of clinical trial activities; fines under Decreto 780/2016; revocation of authorization may prevent continued CRO operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual information return for shareholders and beneficial owners (Información exógena) if applicable under DIAN thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Usually due between mid-August and late October based on the final digit of the NIT; annual calendar published by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties up to 5% of the information value, with minimum fines; repeat non-compliance considered a tax infraction under Estatuto Tributario

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual report on transactions with related parties and transfer pricing documentation if the CRO exceeds applicable thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (with supporting documentation maintained in company files)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual corporate income tax return; due within the deadline set by DIAN for the claim month (September/October) based on NIT last digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines for incomplete documentation or untimely filing equal to 1% of the transaction value or 10,000 UVT (approx. USD 120,000), whichever is greater; non-compliance triggers transfer pricing penalty and special audit risk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual meeting minutes recording the approval of the prior year's financial statements and discharge of management
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Minute book maintained by the S.A.S.; copy filed in the Chamber of Commerce if legal representatives change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first four months of the year (March 31 latest) unless calendar year differs; extraordinary meetings as needed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of the approval minute delays renewal and creates legal uncertainty; penal clauses and liability of directors may be activated

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for any Colombian entity whose total gross assets exceed 5000 SMLMV (monthly minimum wage units) as of December 31, or whose gross income exceeds 3000 SMLMV, or when it qualifies as a foreign company branch, financial entity, public-interest entity, or when shareholders expressly designate a statutory auditor (revisor fiscal). A CRO conducting clinical trials for multinational sponsors typically must appoint a statutory auditor if the above financial thresholds are met or if the company is classified by the Superintendencia de Sociedades as a 'gran contribuyente' or subject to external control.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB, adopted in Colombia under Law 1314/2009 and applicable in full for 'Grupo 1' entities; Grupo 2 entities apply the IFRS for SMEs, issued as Decreto 2420/2015. Colombian residual local GAAP applies for certain limited Grupo 3 entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Colombian S.A.S. must complete an annual beneficial ownership survey and update the share register with respect to transfers of equity interests within 30 days of the transfer. The company must report the UBO information to DIAN through the annual informational return (Información exógena) and to the Cámara de Comercio when filing the annual renewal. Failure to update UBO details triggers a presumption of defective compliance and subjects the company to fines under Law 2010 of 2019 and anti-money laundering regulations. The S.A.S. must also keep full identification, residency and capital contribution data for every shareholder and maintain a chronological share ledger covering transfers, transmission, usufruct and any equity-linked contracts.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 - USD 1,200 per year for a registered office and commercial agent in Bogotá or Medellín, depending on entity size and corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - USD 5,800 per year for a certified independent audit of a mid-sized CRO S.A.S. depending on transaction volume, intercompany operations and trial sponsorship complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for FY2025 (Law 2277/2022; said rates apply from the 2023 taxable year onward)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General 35% CIT. No industry-specific holiday for ISIC 7490 CRO services. Notable reliefs: (i) 20% reduced Zona Franca rate only if operating under the Zona Franca regime; (ii) 25% income tax discount for investments in Science, Technology & Innovation projects approved by the Ministry of Science (Art. 256-1 E.T.), applicable to qualifying clinical-research investments; (iii) unlimited deduction of R&D-related expenditures with credit recognition upon STI project endorsement. Dividend-tax credit at the shareholder level is not available for the 10% dividend surtax, which remains a real cash cost upon repatriation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_regime_note: Fiscal losses ('exceso de pérdidas fiscales') carry forward indefinitely per Art. 147 E.T. (Law 1819/2016), but annual utilization is capped at 25% of the taxable net income of the year. Losses cannot be carried back.
